en.basel-kadem: 2.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Khalid, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jameel bin Saleh, from Muhammed bin Marwan, that he said: I said to Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him:

Did the Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, say: «Indeed, Fatima shielded her private organ, to which Allah forbade her offspring from the Fire»? He said: Yes, by that he meant Hasan, Hussain, Zainab and Umm Kulthum.
